tests.title: Full mock paper (35 marks, 1.5 hours)
tests.patternSource: PCI B.Pharm regulations, question paper pattern for a 35-mark end-semester theory paper: Section I long answers, answer 1 out of 2 (10 marks); Section II short answers, answer 5 out of 7 (5 marks each). BP106RBT is a Non University Examination, so your college sets the paper. Confirm with your college.

tests.title: Sessional mock (30 marks, 1 hour)
tests.patternSource: PCI B.Pharm regulations, sessional pattern for subjects with a Non University Examination: long answers 1 out of 2 × 10, short answers 4 out of 6 × 5. Confirm with your college.
